purpose: A frozen fast-loop benchmark for ordinary named POIs in the commercial-feed regime, independent of every compared provider.
rules: Every case names one real, ordinary POI and carries no expected_gers_id.
Gold coordinates and accepted names come from the cited source, never from Overture, Nominatim, or Photon.
A case whose source is OSM-derived is eligible only for Overture and must exclude Nominatim and Photon.
Non-OSM cases are eligible for all three providers.
Generic intents such as restaurants near me are excluded; this file scores exact named-place retrieval.
Changing a numeric gate requires a new spec generation rather than silently weakening this one.
